title: Nadia, 33 — what her period app does with her data
caption:
Your period app isn't covered by HIPAA (HHS, June 2022).
In 2021 the FTC said Flo shared cycle and pregnancy data with Facebook and Google.
Open yours and search the policy for "third parties."
Kept it or deleted it?
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #dataprivacy #cycletracking #femtech #periodapp #digitalprivacy

scenes.text: My cycle app knows I'm *trying*. Who else does?

scenes.text: Tonight: search the app's policy for *'third parties'*, then switch off ad tracking.
phrases: 1. Search its privacy policy for 'third parties' or 'sell'.
2. Turn off app tracking in your phone's privacy settings.
3. Use the app's 'download my data' and 'delete account' options.
